d.t: Metal washer for spot fastening in overlaps and intermediate fastening in mechanically fastened roofing systems
d.s: Zinc plated steel washes with diamond-shaped reinforcement and specially stamped barbs for the mechanical fastening of roof waterproofing membranes. Hole diameter 7.5 mm.
a: Easy to use and install with recommended tools
us: Mechanically fastened roof waterproofing membranes by spot fastening in overlaps and / or intermediate spot fastening in combination with fastener Sarnafast SBF-6.0 or SBF-S-6.0. Only for fastening roof waterproofing membranes over compressible thermal insulation (not for use on hard substrates).
d.pk: Loose, packaging unit 250 pieces / box Article No.: 111097

sec.t: Quality Management System EN ISO 9001/14001 European Technical Approval ETA-08/0262 Factory Mutual Class No. 4470
Sarnafast KTL does not expire during correct storage.
Sarnafast KTL shall be stored in dry conditions.
82 × 40 mm, hole diameter 7.5 mm, thickness 1 mm
Ancillary products: Sarnafast Fastener SBF-6.0 Sarnafast Fastener SBF-S-6.0
15 cycles Kesternich test (concentration SFW 2.0 S in accordance with DIN 50018) according to ETAG 006 – D.3.1.

Installation works to be carried out only by experienced Sika trained roofing contractors. Additional measures may be required for installation at below +5 °C ambient temperature in accordance with all relevant local regulations.
